title: What the house still needs
lead: Materials and things that are still missing to rebuild. If someone has already pledged to bring an item, it stops being offered here.
paragraphs: This list is not a request for money. It is what the work needs in kind: roof sheets, bags, metres of something specific. Each line says how many are needed and how many remain.
Without a real photo none is invented. The space is reserved and the caption says what will be seen there. An unpublished item does not appear: if it is not on this page, it is not being offered yet.

When someone signs up to bring a unit, that unit is no longer available. The same thing cannot be donated twice. Pledging opens once the account is enabled; until then, this page says what is missing.
seoDescription: What materials and things Norma’s house still needs, and how much remains to be covered.
emptyTitle: No list has been published yet
emptyBody: When the team loads what is still needed, it appears here. In the meantime there are other ways to help.
